t: 安禄山称帝，建立短命的燕国。
te: An Lushan proclaims himself Emperor of China, founding the short-lived state of Yan.
dz: 安禄山称帝，建立短命的燕国。
de: An Lushan proclaims himself Emperor of China, founding the short-lived state of Yan.

dz: Abd al-Rahman一世是统治了伊伯利亚大部近三个世纪的阿拉伯王朝的建立者,他成为了西班牙克多瓦的埃米尔.
de: Abd al-Rahman I, the founder of the Arab dynasty that ruled the greater part of Iberia for nearly three centuries, becomes emir of Cordova, Spain.

dz: 安禄山之乱：唐玄宗奉禁军之命，处决宰相杨国忠，迫使他自杀或叛变。安禄山将军杀害了其他皇亲国戚。
de: An Lushan Rebellion: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang is ordered by his Imperial Guards to execute chancellor Yang Guozhong by forcing him to commit suicide or face a mutiny. General An Lushan has other members of the emperor's family killed.
